invariants: The current-function count is reset only by parse_function and monotonically increments only when read_value_name fills a vacant name record; capacity remains 2048.
read_value_name tests size before other name fields. Its vacant-record path overwrites begin, size and index before later lookup can observe them.
define is the only nonzero SSA type writer. Before writing block origin it rejects invalid indexes, invalid types and existing nonzero types.
Every define caller obtains the index from expect(...256), directly or via owned_read_outputs/result scratch. expect dispatches value-name tokens to read_value_name.
Slots outside the current count cannot have nonzero type after reset, so the original loan_live predicate was false there regardless of dirty CAP or origin bytes.
check_graph clears current block types but does not shrink the name count; fixed-source replay reads names already interned during the initial parse.
Full bulk reset additionally changes unused origin and vacant-name bytes. These are private scratch; no byte-identical scratch postimage or instruction trace is asserted.
native_validation: Independent native differential tests are owned by audit_compiler; no result from that run is included or inferred here.
scope: semantic admission and emitted artifacts in the existing bounded compiler profile; scratch postimage/store trace and whole-language proof are not claimed
